description: Remakes a clip with the user's subject: `swap` puts it IN the shot, `motion` has it do the clip's moves. Returns the new job's id. WHEN: 'put my product in this video', 'make him do these moves'. Read `get_recipe` `reshot` first. CONSENT: a real person's picture only with their permission, never a public figure or celebrity. THE CARD: this call already opened the aicut card: do not call `show_generation` for this job. WAIT: `wait_for_generation` (this id, `media`), again at once while `terminal: false`, then one short line; no `get_*` polling, timers, background shells or narrating the wait. No card? Give the user the `url`. COST: the server-measured clip length times a per-second rate by resolution. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, ask in the SAME message as the price, and wait for a go that names THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES, this server's instructions). IDEMPOTENCY: a reused `idempotency_key` REPLAYS the first job whatever the settings: never reuse one for a new generation (this server's instructions).

prompt.description: Optional; @Video1 is the clip, @Image1... the pictures.

resolution.description: REQUIRED: use `720p` unless the user asked for `1080p`, and name the choice in the priced ask; never carried over from an earlier request.

source_video.description: The clip, 4 to 30 seconds. A URL from this account's generations or uploads, or a public https URL (imported first); another account's is refused.

name: reshot_video
title: Reshot: swap who is in a clip, or transfer its moves
